{{< include _load_data.qmd >}}

```{r}
#| label: test-tmp

elections$data |>
  map_dfr(\(x) select(x, nb_votant, nb_procu, scrutin)) |>
  mutate(scrutin = if_else(scrutin == "Législative", "Législatives", scrutin)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = nb_votant, y = nb_procu, color = scrutin)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .2, size = .5)
```
